svg.aria-label: Simar Bhatia — AI & Machine Learning Engineer
svg.title: Simar Bhatia
svg.desc: Portfolio header card: Simar Bhatia, AI and Machine Learning Engineer and Product Designer, first-year M.Tech at VIT Vellore, focus areas in machine learning, data science, NLP and LLMs, and product design.

g.text: I'm a first-year M.Tech student in Computer Science and Engineering with a growing passion for Artificial Intelligence
and Machine Learning. I love turning ideas into intelligent applications, whether it's experimenting with machine learning
models, building AI-powered tools, or developing full-stack products with a strong backend foundation.
These days, I'm focused on learning more about deep learning, generative AI, LLMs, and backend system design while
documenting my journey through projects and open-source contributions.
